mainEntity.name: Do I need a local installer for natural stone tile, or can any tile company do it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes—local conditions matter because homes in the Denver metro area can have different subfloors, moisture exposure, and temperature swings that affect installation performance. A local installer should check whether your specific room needs extra prep, sealing, or waterproofing before the stone goes down.
acceptedAnswer.description: A local installer is helpful because they can account for Denver-area moisture, temperature changes, and subfloor conditions. That matters a lot with natural stone, which is less forgiving than standard tile.
